_comment: Fernhollow Cacao 'Dark Bar Sizzle' food-product sizzle — THE WORKED EXAMPLE. Copy to config.json and edit. A ~14s warm-tungsten macro-tabletop 9:16 sizzle for a physical small-batch dark-chocolate bar: WORDLESS (no VO), driven by a non-diegetic acoustic-jazz bed + diegetic snap/tear SFX. Pipeline: (1) ~4 photographic macro keyframes via create-image-fal (the box hero grounds on the REAL product PNG); (2) one locked-off anti-shake create-video-fal i2v clip per keyframe (snap / flat-lay / bite / box-hero); (3) an ElevenLabs Music ~22s acoustic-jazz bed trimmed of its 2.5s sparse intro + two ffmpeg-lavfi diegetic SFX; (4) a STATIC PIL end card (real Fernhollow logo PNG + real product PNG + serif headline + CTA) + ffmpeg filter_complex concat + anti-AI grain pass + audio composite + 5 serif stat-callout pills. Master 1080x1920 h264+aac, ~14.04s (24fps). See scripts/PIPELINE.md for the pipeline steps. Creative fields — look_pack.style_descriptor, look_pack.palette_anchors, scenes[].keyframe_prompt, scenes[].motion_hint, end_card.background, music.prompt — come from the recipe's choices (setting, light, hands, music); never copy them as defaults. The warm-tungsten pantry, the baker's hands and the acoustic-jazz bed are this demo's picks, not the format.
title: Roasted slow. Snapped fresh.

look_pack.name: WARM_TUNGSTEN_PANTRY
look_pack._name_note: the demo's look pack (setting + light choices); name yours after the chosen setting + light
palette_anchors: warm tungsten window daylight, slightly desaturated
look_pack.style_descriptor: Tactile macro-tabletop food photography, warm tungsten pantry register, parchment + walnut board + marble slab + linen surfaces, warm window daylight raking from camera-left, slight 35mm film grain. Photographic, NOT cinematic, NOT smooth. iPhone-shot daytime kitchen feel, NOT studio polish. Sharp focus on the product. 1080x1920 vertical.
look_pack.negative_tail: NO studio polish, NO bokeh, NOT shallow DOF, NO smooth digital 3D render, NO AI-illustration look. NO invented label text, NO captions, NO brand wordmarks rendered by the model (the brand appears only on the composited end card). NO faces beyond a partial jaw / hands crop. Vertical 9:16 composition.
look_pack._note: ONE look pack drives all 4 keyframes so the sizzle reads as one spot. Palette sampled from the brand's packaging + site (brand-research/visual-identity.md). The 'no invented label text' negative is load-bearing — the box hero grounds on the real product PNG so the label is real.

keyframe_engine.product_ref: S04 (box hero) passes the real dark-bar-72.png (+ the second-flavor box) as media[role=image] with 'reproduce the label EXACTLY, invent no text'; S01/S02/S03 pass no product ref
keyframe_engine._note: The box-hero request threads the real product PNGs as media input and tells the model to reproduce the label exactly. NEVER include readable brand text in a prompt — the model garbles it into typos.

clip_engine.anti_shake_tail: Camera is locked off, tripod-stable. NO shake, NO wobble, NO earthquake. Slow, deliberate motion only.
clip_engine._note: Locked-off, anti-shake. Submitted SEQUENTIALLY (gen_clips_hf.sh) to avoid the burst-credit reserve gate. Per-scene durations match tStart/tEnd — S01/S02 3s, S03/S04 4s.

music.prompt: Upbeat warm acoustic jazz instrumental. Bright felt-piano melody as the lead voice with a walking upright bass and very light brushed snare. Cozy café register, small-batch artisan food-brand feel. NO vocals, NO horn solo, NO heavy drums. Mid-tempo, major key, gently swinging groove. The piano and bass should start IMMEDIATELY with a clear melodic phrase — do NOT begin with silence or a long sparse intro. Builds slightly in energy toward the end with one tasteful piano run around the 16-second mark.
music._note: gen_music_v2.py requests 22s to allow the 2.5s sparse-intro trim; build_master_v2.sh step 1 trims start=2.5, loudnorm I=-16, fade in 0.4s + fade out 1.0s, clamps -t to the FULL master length. target_length_sec MUST equal duration_sec (body, 14.04) + end_card.hold_sec (3.0) = 17.04 so the bed plays under the end card and fades on the tail — audio_mix.music_over_end_card is true, so a 14.04 bed would leave the 3s end card silent. No artist names (ElevenLabs Music ToS filter).

cues.name: snap
cues.note: crisp white-noise crack at the bar snap (S01), highpass 900 / lowpass 5500, acompressor

cues.name: tear
cues.note: pink-noise pull at the box-open / hand reach (S04), highpass 350 / lowpass 4000

sfx._note: Two short diegetic hits synthesized with ffmpeg lavfi anoisesrc (make_sfx.sh) at measured cue points.

scenes.keyframe_prompt: Slow-motion macro: two flour-dusted hands hold a thick dark chocolate bar at a scored break line on parchment, glossy snap edge visible, a few cocoa crumbs. Warm window daylight from camera-left.
scenes.motion_hint: The two flour-dusted hands snap the dark chocolate bar in half along the score line; the clean glossy break edge catches the light; a few cocoa crumbs fall straight down with gravity; hands stay in frame, daylight steady from camera-left.

scenes.keyframe_prompt: Top-down flat lay of four chocolate squares fanned on parchment next to a small pile of cacao nibs and flaky salt. Warm daylight, slight film grain.
scenes.motion_hint: Gentle slow 2% top-down push-in on the flat lay; a tiny breath of air lifts one parchment corner slightly; salt flakes catch the light; otherwise still life.

scenes.keyframe_prompt: Side profile, ONLY the jaw and lower lip in frame (eyes and forehead cropped OUT), a woman about to bite a chocolate square. Background defocused warm cream-brown, small gold stud earring consistent.
scenes.motion_hint: The woman bites cleanly into the chocolate square — a crisp snap, then a slow, satisfied chew; background stays defocused warm cream-brown; the earring stays consistent.

scenes.keyframe_prompt: Locked medium shot. The EXACT Fernhollow Cacao Dark 72 bar box (from the reference PNG) stands upright on a walnut pantry shelf with a linen cloth. A woman's hand enters from the right edge, fingers reaching to slide one wrapped bar out. A second-flavor box (from the reference) sits in soft focus behind. Reproduce the box label EXACTLY as in the reference — invent no text, no captions, no stickers.
scenes.motion_hint: The hand enters from the right, fingers gently grasp one wrapped bar and slide it slowly straight up out of the box; the box itself stays put; the second box stays still in soft focus behind; daylight from camera-left holds steady.

end_card.headline: Roasted slow. Snapped fresh.
end_card._note: make_end_card.py composes scene-S05.png entirely in PIL — cream #F4EEE3 bg + the real brand wordmark PNG (upper third) + the real product PNG (centered, soft shadow) + the serif headline + the CTA. NEVER AI-rendered. A promo line in the CTA is optional. Uses a middle dot ' · ' (macOS serif em-dash gap).

stat_callouts._note: The demo burns 5 serif stat-callout pills (cream or deep-cacao pill, serif type) at choreographed beats via build_master_v2.sh drawtext. % strings ('72% CACAO', '15% OFF') are written to textfiles (c1.txt / c5.txt) with expansion=none — drawtext reads a raw % as a strftime spec.

grain_pass._note: Anti-AI-look grain applied globally in build_master_v2.sh so the sizzle doesn't read AI-smooth.

audio_mix._note: The acoustic-jazz bed is the full audio bed — no VO to duck under. snap.wav (~1.5s) + tear.wav (~11s) mix in at their cue points. The bed plays UNDER the end card and fades out over the tail — no trailing silence.

music.note: non-diegetic acoustic-jazz bed (no vocals), sparse intro trimmed, loudnorm + fades

sfx.note: diegetic snap (bar break) + tear (box-open) at measured cue points

grain.note: anti-AI-look grain (eq + hqdn3d + noise) applied globally

stat_callouts.note: 5 serif stat-callout pills at beats (cacao % / ingredients / process / promo)

end_card.note: static PIL end card (real logo PNG + real product PNG + serif headline + CTA), music under it
